local getEnvironment = getfenv
local luaNext = next
local luaSelect = select
local setEnvironment = setfenv
local function bindEnvironment(fn, environment, deferEnvironment)
    if not deferEnvironment then
        setEnvironment(fn, environment)
    end
    return fn
end
local luaUnpack = unpack
local native_Vector2_new = Vector2.new
local native_Vector3_new = Vector3.new
local native_coroutine_wrap = coroutine.wrap
local native_table_create = table.create
local native_table_move = table.move
local native_table_pack = table.pack
local native_alias_coroutine_yield = coroutine.yield
local function buildCaptures(registers, inherited, registry, spec, count)
    local captures = count > 0 and {}
    if captures then
        for i = 1, count do
            local offset = (i - 1) * 2
            local kind, slot = spec[offset + 1], spec[offset + 2]
            if kind == 0 then
                registry = if not registry then {} else registry
                local cell = registry[slot]
                if not cell then
                    cell = {[6] = registers, [3] = slot}
                    registry[slot] = cell
                end
                captures[i] = cell
            elseif kind == 3 then
                captures[i] = registers[slot]
            elseif kind == 1 then
                captures[i] = {[6] = registers, [3] = slot}
            elseif kind == 2 then
                captures[i] = inherited[slot]
            end
        end
    end
    return captures, registry
end
local factories = {}
local function captureRegister(openUpvalues, registers, index)
    local cell = openUpvalues[index]
    if not cell then
        cell = {[6] = registers, [3] = index}
        openUpvalues[index] = cell
    end
    return cell
end

local function closeCell(openUpvalues, registers, index, cell)
    if cell then
        cell[6] = cell
        cell[5] = registers[index]
        cell[3] = 5
        openUpvalues[index] = nil
    end
end

local function closeRegister(openUpvalues, registers, index)
    if not openUpvalues then
        return
    end
    closeCell(openUpvalues, registers, index, openUpvalues[index])
end

local function closeAll(openUpvalues, registers)
    if not openUpvalues then
        return
    end
    for index in luaNext, openUpvalues do
        closeRegister(openUpvalues, registers, index)
    end
end

local function vmHelper_jy(argument_1, argument_2, argument_3)
    local local_4 = native_alias_coroutine_yield
    local_4()
    local local_5 = true
    for item_6, item_7 in argument_1, argument_2, argument_3 do
        local_4(local_5, item_6, item_7)
    end
end

        end

            return

                    value_19 = environment.Animations[value_17.Name]

                if value_19 then

                end
            end
            return
        end
    end
    return bindEnvironment(function_1574, environment, deferEnvironment)
end
